title: Request for Quotations for Elevator Preventative Maintenance Services
agency: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.AMERICAN CONSULATE CAPE TOWN
description_text: he U.S. Department of State is soliciting quotations under RFQ No. 19SF2026Q0008 for Elevator Preventative Maintenance Services at the U.S. Consulate General Cape Town, South Africa. The Government intends to award a Firm-Fixed-Price contract consisting of a one-year base period plus four (4) one-year option periods, using a Lowest-Priced Technically Acceptable (LPTA) evaluation method. A pre-quotation conference/site visit will be held on May 12, 2026, at 10:00 SAST at the U.S. Consulate General Cape Town, 2 Reddam Avenue, Westlake. Prospective offerors must contact Natheer Ford (Fordn@state.gov) by May 8, 2026, at 9:00 SAST to arrange entry. Vendors must provide full attendee name(s), government-issued ID number(s), and vehicle details if parking onsite. Quotations are due no later than May 22, 2026, at 17:00 SAST. Interested vendors should refer to the full solicitation package for complete requirements and submission instructions.
